title: OL-20261115-22: Raise k_eff from 0.068 to k_min: dispatch yield is the limiting term
body:
**Owner:** portfolio-manager
**Trigger:** every tick: seed/worker/src/ignition.js files IGNITE-critical
**Done check:** grep:seed/worker/src/ignition.js::IGNITE-
**Status:** open

The live runtime spends 556 dispatch units per 14 days for 18 verified deploys and 20 originated credits. IGNITE-critical is filed by the tick with the current numbers each tick and closes when k_eff holds at or above k_min for six ticks.
